newsitem.title: GERMANY: Missing German sausage maker's car found.
newsitem.headline: Missing German sausage maker's car found.

text.p: German police said on Thursday they have found the car of a wealthy sausage manufacturer and his wife who disappeared from their home on Monday.
Police discovered traces of human blood in the house and a large pool of blood in the garage of Peter Schulte-Berthold, 43, and his wife Christine, 37.
The Bochum state prosecutor said DNA tests being carried out would establish whether the blood belonged to Schulte-Berthold or his wife.
Their nephew, who reported the pair missing, also found two plane tickets to Budapest lying on the kitchen table in the house in Witten in western Germany.
Police say they are investigating all possibilities but add the two could have been the victims of kidnapping or murder. They gave no further details about where the car was found.
Schulte-Berthold is managing director of Zimmerman sausage factory, part of an extensive holding company of 18 firms.
